Both correctly identify the stale fixture pin and missing switch. Do not invest in full suites or repeat this unchanged sample. This is one diagnostic task, not proof that every possible CI task has no value.

Root found no compelling unmet task, so no dependency-analysis Skill or full paired suite was created. This was an unscored baseline-only diagnostic.
Both investigations and their raw evidence are committed and pushed. No production operation occurred. Existing branches and candidates remain intact.
